products.title: DayFlex Multiway Fold Waist Cycling Shorts - Cool Espresso
products.body_html:
You LOVE our Multi-way Fold Waist Wide Leg Yoga Pants so, of course, we had to recreate her for summer in our Cycling Short style. Bodies change daily, and an adjustable waist means you control the comfort. Our Dayflex collection is crafted using 75% Recycled Nylon for durability and strength (saved from waste) and 25% Lycra for the perfect 4-way stretch.

  • Centre back embroidered TALA logo 

  • Leg shaping as per Dayflex Flare 

  • Multiway fold over waist - can be worn low waisted

  • Inseam length - 11.5cm as per size Small

  • Consciously created with sustainability in mind, made from 75% recycled nylon and 25% LYCRA® SPORT

 

Responsibility:

This item is made from Recycled Nylon from pre-consumer waste (aka factory offcuts) certified by the Global Recycle Standard. 

  • Average impact savings vs. virgin Nylon = Co2 emissions reduced by up to 76%.
  • Audited, Ethical Factories: Ethically Made in China. For more information visit here
  • WRAP (Gold) certification for responsible production. 
  • Sedex-SMETA audited for worker health and safety. 
  • Oeko-Tex Standard 100 tested and certified for no harmful substances.


Treat me with care... 

All TALA items are made to last. By caring for our clothes we prolong their life, so they can be worn, over and over again.

  • Turn inside out to wash
  • Wash dark colours separately
  • Delicate machine wash at  30°C
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not iron
  • Do not dry clean
  • Can be steamed to remove creases

    Model info: 

    Elissa // UK 8 // Tala size XS // 5’9

    Impact information based on secondary data. Correct at the time of publishing.

products.title: Halter Plunge Gold Ring Bikini Top - Black Onyx
products.body_html:
You loved her so much last year, we had to bring her back. Remember our Cairo Multiway Bikini Top? The Celeste is her new younger sister who’s had a gorgeous fabric glow-up. She’s still the most versatile bikini top you will ever own, but this time she’s been created in a new super durable fabric that still feels soft, and sexy. With unlimited ways to style, she’s guaranteed to be ultra-flattering for every body shape. One bikini and several different looks means this can be the only bikini in your suitcase - just pick your favourite bottom to get a fully customised look.

  • Multiway, tapered strap design to style your way

  • Triangle Cup Shape 

  • Ruched Under Bust Channel

  • Adjustable support and coverage 

  • Easily adjustable tie back

  • Consciously created with sustainability in mind, made from 81% Recycled Polyamide, 19% Elastane

Model info:

Maria // Height 5’8 // UK size 8 // TALA size M

Treat me with care…

All TALA items are made to last. By caring for our clothes we prolong their life, so they can be worn, over and over again.

  • Rinse well after use
  • Cool hand wash only
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not iron
  • Do not dry clean
  • Dry away from direct heat and sunlight
  • Dry flat
  • To prevent discolouration and loss of elasticity, minimise exposure to hot tubs
  • Avoid direct contact with suntan lotions and oils
  • Swimwear can only be returned with hygiene stickers in place

 

This fabric is made from 81% recycled Polyamide, 19% elastane from pre-consumer waste, certified by the Global Recycle Standard. 

Recycled polyamide in this product comes from pre-consumer waste, which are wastes derived before they reach the consumer. This utilises yarn or fabric offcuts and needs recycling to be put again in production. 

Audited, Ethical factories: Made in Turkey. 

Sedex-SMETA audited for worker health and safety. 

Oeko-Tex Standard 100 tested and certified for no harmful substances.

Read about our factories and fabrics here
